title: Add Bold Tag in String
summary: Given a string and an array of words, add and tags to wrap substrings in the string that match any word in the array.
statement: Given a string and an array of words, add and tags to wrap substrings in the string that match any word in the array. Combine overlapping and consecutive bolded substrings into a single tag.
constraints: Wrap every matching substring; merge overlapping or adjacent bold regions.
hints: Treat matched characters as a union of intervals.
Mark every character covered by any match, then emit maximal marked runs.
Find all starts, mark spans, and surround each consecutive true run once.
A boolean coverage array automatically merges overlap and adjacency while preserving unmatched characters.
editorial: A boolean coverage array automatically merges overlap and adjacency while preserving unmatched characters.

tests.explanation: The two separated matches receive separate bold regions.
Overlapping and adjacent matches merge into one region covering aaabbc.
